# fhir-validator-lite

> FHIR R4 JSON resource validator driven by StructureDefinition snapshots that checks cardinality, datatypes, choice types and required bindings and emits OperationOutcome Maven artifact `io.github.trysac:fhir-validator-lite`, Java package
> `io.github.trysac.fhir_validator_lite`, MIT licensed, Java >= 21, standard library only.

- [AGENTS](AGENTS.md): commands, folder map, conventions, limits
- [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): shape of the library and its public API
- [Testing](docs/TESTING.md): how to run and extend the tests
